properties.description: Permanent Lake residing in the campus of Delhi Technological University. Depth of the lake is deeper than 6 feet.

properties.name: Najafgarh Nallah
properties.description: The Najafgarh Nallah is a channelized waterway that was once a part of the Sahibi River and an elongation of the Najafgarh Jheel Lake. It flows through rural southwest Delhi and ultimately outfalls into the Yamuna River.

properties.name: Sheetla Mata Pilgrimage Pond
properties.description: Sacred pilgrimage pond at Sheetla Mata Mandir. Part of temple redevelopment project. Devotees traditionally bathe and offer prayers at the pond.
properties.description:2: Pond has been part of temple complex for centuries;reconstructed during current redevelopment
